post.originalText:
One prompt. Claude Opus 5.5.

It invented the concept, wrote the credits, animated every frame and made its own music + SFX.

No After Effects. No stock footage. No AI video model.

An Emmy-style title sequence for a show that doesn't exist. Insane.

Prompt in the replies 👇 https://t.co/cu6IwiaBqF
